guided_practice.task_and_answer: Enumerate the nine rows with L1=0. Classify full registry by nonzero-coordinate count: 0->1, 1->6, 2->12, 3->8.

lessons.bridge_to_teach: Define root, depth, child and parent by a finite rule; distinguish a cell from its vertices. Teach interval subdivision on a number line before 3D counts.

worked_example.task_and_answer: Synthetic unit interval [0,1): split into [0,1/2),[1/2,1), then four quarter intervals. Child indices j=0..3 at depth2 have parent floor(j/2).

guided_practice.task_and_answer: Depth3 child j=5 is [5/8,6/8), parent j=2 at depth2 and parent j=1 at depth1.

diagnostic.task_and_answer: At depth2 there are 4 interval cells and 5 distinct boundary vertices, not 8. Endpoint 1 is a geometric vertex even though excluded from the half-open interval.

typed_count_bridge.worked: A centered window has3 half-step positions per axis, yielding27 nodes. A Lucas Group has3 complete cells per axis, yielding27 VOLUMES and outer basis3B. Draw a1D row with three cell centers and four boundary corners to distinguish nodes and volumes.

worked_example.task_and_answer: For a synthetic group root 3B: dyadic n2=0 gives 27 cells, 64 vertices; n2=1 gives 216 cells,343 vertices. Ternary depth d3=1 has 27 address classes; d3=2 has729.

guided_practice.task_and_answer: One coordinate of A2 is represented by 0..8. Residue 7 reduces to1 modulo3; (-2) modulo3 also gives1. In 3D (7,5,0) maps to(1,2,0).

diagnostic.task_and_answer: Equal counts do not identify objects: 27 geometric volumes at n2=0 are not the same typed object as 27 ternary address classes at d3=1.

rung_equation_bridge.introduce: For this source equation only, g_rung and n_rung are nonnegative integers. They are not automatically the independently named dyadic depth n2 or ternary address depth d3.
rung_equation_bridge.worked: 3^g_rung*2^n_rung+1=10 becomes3^g_rung*2^n_rung=9. The right side is odd, so n_rung=0. Then3^g_rung=9, so g_rung=2.
rung_equation_bridge.practice: Bound g_rung<=2 and n_rung<=3 using monotone nonnegative powers, and check the12 candidate pairs; only(2,0) works.
rung_equation_bridge.diagnostic: State the domain before claiming uniqueness; identify how the resulting outer9B count729 differs from ternary residue cardinality27^2, despite their equal numbers.

lessons.bridge_to_teach: Derive shared-boundary counts from vertices along each axis, and length/area/volume scaling from products. State which root stays fixed.

worked_example.task_and_answer: For fixed outer 3B, each depth-n2 subcell has basis 2^-n2 B; cells=27*8^n2 and merged corner vertices=(3*2^n2+1)^3. At n2=2:1728 cells,2197 vertices.

guided_practice.task_and_answer: From n2=1 to2, subcell length halves, face area quarters, volume divides by8; total occupied volume stays27*|det B|=162 synthetic length^3.

diagnostic.task_and_answer: At n2=1, 216*8=1728 counts cell-vertex incidences, not the343 distinct vertices. Explain shared vertices. Do not confuse B_(p,n)=3^p*2^-n B with the fixed outer group boundary.

lessons.bridge_to_teach: Teach balanced ternary by place values 1,3,9. Store depth and list digits least-significant first to make the parent operation unambiguous.

worked_example.task_and_answer: Digits (epsilon0,epsilon1,epsilon2)=(-1,0,1) represent8. Modulo27 that is class8; its depth2 reduction is class8 modulo9, represented by balanced digits(-1,0) with integer representative-1.

guided_practice.task_and_answer: Integer5 has digits(-1,-1,1), since -1-3+9=5. At depth2 its balanced representative is-4, congruent to5 modulo9; at depth1 representative-1 is congruent to2 modulo3.

diagnostic.task_and_answer: The same residue can have different integer representatives. Recover a finite integer only when digit list and depth are retained; a reduced residue alone loses the high digit.

guided_practice.task_and_answer: Depth3 class5 reduces to depth2 class5 then depth1 class2; balanced representatives5,-4,-1. Check differences9 and-3.

diagnostic.task_and_answer: Dropping epsilon0 from(-1,0,1) and shifting places gives3, not the depth2 parent class8. Keep the low digits and discard only the highest digit when reducing depth.
